Revise: the same horizontal row containing five distinct colored rectangular pads, and this time the pads are designed with rounded corners instead of sharp edges.
statement: This sketch presents a musical interface with five colorfully lit pads arranged horizontally across the canvas. Each pad features rounded corners and a distinct solid color. When a user clicks on any pad, it instantly illuminates with a bright white glow while simultaneously playing a corresponding musical note — C4, D4, E4, F4, or G4 — using p5's oscillator functions. The other pads remain static until another is clicked, creating an interactive musical experience where each pad serves as both a visual trigger and sound generator. The interface responds to the single gesture of clicking the center of the canvas, lighting up the corresponding pad and producing its note, then returning to its original state after a brief duration.
